name: Graves Serling
source:
Your odd-eyed boss Graves seems like he’d be more suited to running a vampire RPG than a cat cafe. He’s got a strange tendency to quote Edgar Allen Poe, a dark past, and a mysterious motivation to protect A Cat’s Paw, and you.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/datenighto/hustle-cat-a-visual-novel-about-a-magical-cat-cafe]Kickstarter[/url]]

[spoiler]Graves has two known forms of magic, metal and cat magic. He is also skilled at ward magic. With his metal magic, Graves could create sculptures out of metal. Now that Nacht has taken his metal magic, he can no longer do so, and Nacht also limited some of Graves' speech, making it so he has a coughing fit when he tries to tell Avery about the situation with Nacht. 

His cat magic allows him to turn himself and others into cats. He turned his workers into cats to pose as familiars because witches often like to kill new witches for fun.[/spoiler]
